prior_high_findings_closed: Receipt branch, digest, parsed value, and verifier inputs now come from one retained descriptor witness.
The process scan catches orphan ./cmix processes by scratch cwd or cgroup membership and does not broadly exclude ancestors.
The canonical full-1G acquisition lock closes the plan-publication versus new-launch race.
Intent and activation receipts bind the dispatch contract, exact predecessor, retained displaced inode, selected and non-selected plans, and exact four-field derivation.
Canonical verifier authority appears only after full-1G lock release.
No dispatcher path executes a verifier or grants Arm-B authority.
remaining_medium_findings: Six directly validated dispatch/recovery schemas are not yet registered in the live-bound shared research-contract registry.
remaining_low_findings: Native codec PID/start is optional in the terminal lease; the contract now attributes native closure to the all-process scan when absent.

review_findings: The dispatcher requires the exact Python runtime and argv, a canonical descriptor-witnessed q1 Arm-A receipt, a total boolean branch, both exact dormant templates, absent intent/activation/displaced/output paths, and both exact-owned locks.

Process closure combines recorded PID/start checks with all-process argv, cwd, cgroup membership, cgroup occupant, and live lease-owner evidence. A clean shell launcher ancestor is ignored only when raw argv binding is its sole reason.
Both verifier output paths are checked before locks, after both locks, and immediately before activation-receipt publication.
The selected activated JSON is independently reversed at exactly four fields and must reproduce the frozen dormant bytes and digest. The displaced dormant inode is separately retained and rebound.

Each verifier consumes the descriptor-derived receipt value, independently validates the activation chain, prepares a complete output under the lock, releases the lock, and atomically publishes without replacement.

The selected plan remains operational_status=dormant_dependency because the generic plan schema has no activated enum; the nested receipt-bound activation object is the sole execution gate and changes are limited to the frozen four paths.
A separate frozen inode-bound recovery transaction now closes the post-intent crash liveness gap without executing a verifier or granting authority.
The design is safe against premature scientific authority. Its remaining registry limitation is provenance work, not a route to score credit.
claim_boundary: This review is static source, schema, and binding evidence only; no dispatcher, verifier, recovery path, or test was executed.
The live qm8 owner, coordinator, guards, stage runner, native codec, candidate, lease, cgroup, result tree, and scratch tree were observed read-only and were not modified or signaled.
No terminal receipt, q1 qualification, Arm-B authorization, archive gain, Gamma score, or Hutter score follows from this review.
